name: ringTimer
meaning: Milliseconds left of the ring, loaded with 0x1000 (4096 ms) when the bell starts and drained by g_dtMs; when it goes negative the bell stops at the next animation loop boundary.

name: voice
meaning: Handle of the ringing sound (id 0x14f); re-played whenever it is 0 or Sound_IsPlaying reports stopped, and stopped on every state change.

name: state
meaning: 1 silent/idle (anim 1, one shot), 2 ringing (anim 0 looping + sound 0x14f + ringTimer), 3 wind-down (anim 2, one shot, then back to 1).
